cohort: Thirty-seven pregnant patients with controlled Type 1 diabetes mellitus were included in the study.
finding: Even in favorable conditions, pregnant patients with Type 1 diabetes mellitus have a great risk for preterm delivery and cesarean section, moderate risk for macrosomia and preeclampsia, and an undefined risk for antenatal death.
mod_finding: Induced vaginal delivery occurred in 24.3% of patients and cesarean section in 72.9% of patients.
